title: 代码评审词汇
html:
代码评审词汇

概述

本章聚焦代码评审场景，分为评审流程、反馈类型、代码质量、自动化检查四个部分。它提供评审中常用的英语词汇，重点是提出和回应评审意见的得体说法。每个部分配有听说例句与写作表达，适合评审评论和讨论。建议把评审流程与反馈类词汇结合学习，做到既指出问题，又保持专业语气。

评审流程

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
pull request (PR) n. 拉取请求 open a PR, review a PR
reviewer n. 审阅者 assign a reviewer, reviewer feedback
approve v. 批准 approve the PR, approved with comments
request changes v. 请求修改 request changes, changes requested
merge v. 合并 merge to main, squash and merge
LGTM abbr. 看起来不错 LGTM, leave a LGTM comment

听说例句

A: Can you review my PR? It's ready for feedback. B: Sure, I'll take a look this afternoon. If it looks good, I'll leave a LGTM and approve it.

A: The reviewer requested changes on the error handling logic. B: Let me address the feedback and push an update. I'll re-request the review after.

写作表达

  • All pull requests require at least one reviewer approval before merging to the main branch.
  • The code review process includes automated linting checks and a mandatory human review for logic changes.

反馈类型

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
nit n. 小建议 nit: rename this variable, minor nit
blocker n. 阻断反馈 this is a blocker, blocker comment
suggestion n. 建议 code suggestion, optional suggestion
question n. 疑问 clarifying question, question about logic
praise n. 表扬 leave praise, positive feedback
concern n. 顾虑 raise a concern, performance concern

听说例句

A: I left a few nits on the naming and one blocker on the SQL query. B: Thanks for the feedback. I'll fix the blocker first and address the nits in a follow-up commit.

A: Great refactoring work! The code is much cleaner now. B: Thanks for the praise! Let me know if you have any questions about the new structure.

写作表达

  • Blocker comments must be resolved before the PR can be approved; nits and suggestions are optional.
  • Balancing constructive criticism with praise creates a positive and productive code review culture.

代码质量

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
readability n. 可读性 improve readability, readable code
maintainability n. 可维护性 ensure maintainability, maintainable codebase
DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) adj. 不重复原则 keep it DRY, violates DRY
SOLID adj. SOLID原则 follow SOLID, SOLID principles
edge case n. 边界情况 handle edge cases, missing edge case
naming n. 命名 consistent naming, naming convention

听说例句

A: This function violates the DRY principle — the logic is duplicated in three places. B: Good catch. I'll extract it into a shared utility and improve the naming.

A: Are we handling all edge cases in the input validation? B: Let me add tests for empty strings and null values. Thanks for flagging it.

写作表达

  • Following DRY and SOLID principles during code review ensures long-term maintainability of the codebase.
  • Consistent naming conventions and proper edge case handling are key indicators of code quality.

自动化检查

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
CI check n. 持续集成检查 pass CI checks, CI pipeline
lint v./n. 代码风格检查 run linting, lint errors
static analysis n. 静态分析 static code analysis, analysis tool
test coverage n. 测试覆盖率 coverage report, minimum coverage
pre-commit hook n. 提交前钩子 set up pre-commit, hook runs
automated review n. 自动审查 automated review tool, bot review

听说例句

A: The CI check failed due to lint errors. B: Let me fix the formatting. I should set up a pre-commit hook to catch these locally.

A: What's the minimum test coverage required to merge? B: 80%. The CI pipeline generates a coverage report automatically.

写作表达

  • CI checks including linting, static analysis, and test coverage are enforced as merge prerequisites.
  • Pre-commit hooks prevent common issues from reaching the review stage, improving overall review efficiency.
